Observations from the table that the worker has not used: the deficit is S-specific and HCN-specific in 00493 (N only 12% low, S 39% low). A simple flux-scale error would scale N and S equally; a differential effect points to missing flux/uv coverage (S has extended emission, N compact) or a window/baseline problem (HCN 4-3 at 354.5 GHz sits near the spw edge and next to the vibrational/CS/other lines; the S line is shifted by ~-35 km/s and broad), or to different line integrals because Xb47 (ACA, 4"x2.7") is not uv-matched to 0.7" data. Beam convolution of high-resolution data cannot recover missing short spacings, so image-plane convolution to 4.5" is not a uv-match: the 0.61/0.88 pattern is itself the expected signature of resolved-out flux, which the worker has not tested.

fixes.what: Fix and run the visibility dump, then image every 4-3 MS (per EB and per OUS) with identical settings: common uv range (restrict to the uv overlap of all MS, e.g. 12-100 kλ, or at minimum report the uv-range of each MS from listobs), common Briggs/natural weighting + Gaussian taper to a 1.0" and a 1.5" circular beam, common velocity grid (fixed +-350 km/s window around the same systemic velocity), common phase centre, continuum subtracted with the same line-free channels.
fixes.why: The question is specifically per-MS in uv-matched beams; the current table is image-plane convolution of pipeline cubes, which cannot separate flux scale from uv-coverage.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Use ms.getdata with ifraxis=True (or table.getcol on the DATA/UVW columns) so that u,v keep the [2,nrow] layout, or skip the numpy dump and do uvcontsub + tclean per EB in CASA (uvrange, uvtaper, restoringbeam='common'); measure peak and 1" aperture flux at N and S in each image; list per EB: HCN N,S; HCO+ N,S; N/S ratios and scatter.

fixes.what: Test the missing-flux explanation directly: compare each MS in the overlapping uv annulus (u,v-binned visibility amplitudes of the line-integrated, continuum-subtracted data, or amplitude of the N+S model fitted in uv-plane with two point/Gaussian components + extended component) and compute the S/N ratio of HCN (and HCO+) as a function of uv-radius for 00493, 00223 and Xb47.
fixes.why: The 0.61 (S) vs 0.88 (N) pattern is the differential signature expected from resolved-out extended flux at S; a pure flux-scale error would give equal factors for N and S and the same factor for HCN and HCO+ per EB.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Fit two Gaussian components + uniform disk to the line-integrated visibilities per EB (uvmodelfit or own fit), compare component fluxes between EBs in the shared uv range; compare short-baseline amplitudes between Xb47 (ACA) and 12m EBs where they overlap (~7-25 kλ).

fixes.what: Check the flux scale per EB: get the flux calibrator (Titan/Ceres/J1107-4449/Grid source) flux used and its epoch, the pipeline flux-density table (fluxscale / SourceFlux), the continuum flux of N and S in each EB in the same uv range, and the continuum N/S ratio per EB.
fixes.why: Continuum at the same frequency gives an independent per-EB scale check: if the continuum N and S in 00493 agree with Xb47/Xb4d to <10% at matched uv, the flux scale is excluded and the line discrepancy is in the line extraction.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Image the line-free channels of each MS with the same uv range/taper and compare N and S continuum; compare to 1.3 mm Xb4d and published ALMA calibrator catalogue values at the date; ALMA band-7 absolute accuracy 10-15%, so deviations of 40% require another cause.

fixes.what: Check spectral-window edge, baseline and window effects: print the HCN 4-3 and HCO+ 4-3 spectra at N and S per EB (channel positions in the spw, mean-flag fraction, edge channels); redo the integral with different baseline channel ranges (the +-450-950 km/s baseline in the image-plane step may include HCN-vib/other lines or run off the spw edge in some MS), and with the line window +-250,+-350,+-500 km/s; cvelfreqs outframe/doppler tracking offsets between EBs (2017 vs 2018, different LSRK shifts).
fixes.why: The baseline fit in imgplane.csv assumes line-free channels at 450-950 km/s on both sides in every cube; this is untested, and S has wider wings so a truncated window changes S more than N.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: Overplot per-EB spectra on a common velocity axis, mark the baseline and window; report the integrated flux as a function of window half-width (curve of growth) for each EB and nucleus.

fixes.what: Quantify the effect on the science: replace the 4-3 N/S inputs in q55e_joint with (a) 00493+00223 values, (b) Xb47 values, (c) per-EB uv-matched values with the per-EB scatter as an added systematic, and report the change in ln Bayes factors and in the 'fraction of the contrast already at 1-0'.
fixes.why: The agenda defined this item as the check that decides X-only vs column+abundance; the answer must be carried to the Q55 conclusion even if the discrepancy cannot be fully resolved.
